title: Security and runtime
description: Protections ship on by default. Change them here, from the CLI or the API; a saved value wins over the environment, which wins over the default.

empty.title: No runtime settings registered
empty.body: This build has nothing to configure here yet. Reload after updating the control plane.

readOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings. You can still see the current values.

buildNetwork.title: Build network
buildNetwork.description: Network for RUN steps of a build: open, none, or block-private (reserved: builds fail until it can be enforced). Read on every build.

mcpDefaultTokenScope.title: Default token scope
mcpDefaultTokenScope.description: Scope for a new token created without explicit abilities: read_only or read_write. Existing tokens keep their scope.

restart.title_one: A restart is needed to apply {{count}} change
restart.title_other: A restart is needed to apply {{count}} changes
restart.body: Saved values for restart settings take effect the next time the control plane starts. Running apps keep serving.
restart.confirmBody: The dashboard and API are unavailable for a short moment. Running apps keep serving traffic.
restart.unsupported: This install cannot restart itself. Restart the control plane process yourself, then check again.

confirm.title: Lower this protection?
confirm.body: {{title}} protects this install. Changing it is recorded in the audit log with your name.
confirm.consequence: Anything that relied on it is exposed until you turn it back on.

onboarding.title: Review your security defaults
onboarding.intro: These protections are on by default. Leave them as they are, or change any of them now. You can revisit them later in Settings.

overview.title: Data retention
overview.intro: How long each kind of history is kept. Token windows change here and in Settings, API tokens; the rest are set by environment variable or by their own page.
